name: Diano
source:
An intelligent dark elf skilled in magical arts. She believes that dark elves are the most supreme beings in the whole world, and thus she despises her little brother, who is only half an elf.

Since her knowledge of sexual activities is limited to what is written in books, the demands that the more knowledgeable Ober makes perplex her... but she obeys nevertheless. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1250&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
